title: Step 1: Two Starfleet Teams
text: Welcome to Subspace Intercept. You are divided into Team Alpha and Team Beta. Each team must crack a five-letter override code.

title: Step 2: Transmit Three Clues
text: Each round, everyone gets a secret word and writes three one-word clues. Clue one must start with your assigned letter.

title: Step 3: Borg Assimilation
text: Next, an opposing Borg operative sees your secret word and overwrites one of your three clues with a misleading decoy.

title: Step 4: Ready Up & 30s Decode
text: Tap Ready on your phone to reveal the clues and start the thirty-second timer. Call out your guess in person to unlock a code letter—or risk it all to guess all five!

title: Step 5: Signal Lost
text: If time runs out or you miss, the opposing team unlocks a letter instead. First team to complete their override code wins!
